Corsair has a new Warthog case that follows-up the C70 from 2012, using 2x 200mm front fans and a rear exhaust fan plus a Halo-inspired sci-fi/future military shell. Corsair also has its new semi-phase change pad pre-installed on the Titan II Ultra, has a micro-ATX 2800X, a 12VHPWR warning signal, and... a screw.
